# Pascale B Beauty Lab

## About
Located inside Ecastica Serviced Offices in Limassol, Pascale B Beauty Lab has built a five-star reputation through consistent, detail-oriented work and clients who keep coming back. Pascale B Beauty Lab is a beauty salon in Limassol, Cyprus.

## Services
Sample categories only — replace with Pascale B Beauty Lab's actual current menu and
pricing before this file is published anywhere real:
- Color & Balayage: Full color, highlights, and hand-painted balayage tailored to your hair's natural tone.
- Cuts & Styling: Precision cuts and blowouts for everyday wear or a special occasion.
- Manicure & Nails: Classic and gel manicures in a relaxed, unhurried setting.
- Hair Treatments: Keratin, gloss, and repair treatments for damaged or over-processed hair.
